messages:
maya (oncall): Paging — incident-bot reported elevated 5xx in hosted-inference us-east-1. I'm taking lead and investigating. Initial signal started ~10:12 UTC, error rate ~18%.

incident-bot: Alert triggered: 5xx_rate_up for service=hosted-inference region=us-east-1 pager=maya severity=high

maya (oncall): Symptoms: increased 5xx and interrupted streaming for /v1/generate routes. No obvious GPU saturation on metrics yet. No status page update published. Will gather logs and traceroutes now.

ashok: on it. Pulling logs and traces. Do we have a candidate change around 10:05 UTC?

maya (oncall): There was a config rollout for router cert rotation at 10:05 UTC — suspecting correlation. Not confirmed.

jordan: I can draft quick customer- and status-page-friendly copy. Tone guidance: factual, brief, what customers see, mitigation steps, ETA. Example status page blurb (short):

"We are investigating increased error rates for the Redwood hosted inference API in US‑East (us-east-1). Impact: some requests to /v1/generate may return 5xx or see interrupted streaming. Scope: subset of traffic in the region. Mitigation: routing to fallback nodes and rolling rollback of recent config changes. ETA for partial restoration: ~30 minutes. We will post updates every 20 minutes."

lucy (comms): Good. Keep customer-facing copy short and include explicit recommended action (e.g., retry/backoff). Avoid deep technical detail in public posts.

maya (oncall): Adding internal comms templates to use for slack ops channel and handoffs. Please review and flag edits.

SLACK INTERNAL (ops-urgent):
"Incident 2249991111 | High 5xx in hosted-inference us-east-1
Impact: ~18% 5xx for /v1/generate, streaming interruptions for some sessions
Action: oncall investigating gateway restarts and rollback of recent config rollout
Mitigation in progress: rolling gateway restarts and traffic switch to fallback pool
Owner: maya (oncall)
ETA: ~30m for partial restoration; next update at 2249991311"

ONCALL HANDOFF CHECKLIST (use when handing off):
- Current state and hypothesis
- Actions taken and commands run
- Links: metrics, logs, traces, runbook
- Pending tasks and assignee list
- Comms contacts (primary comms + support escalation)

ashok: logs show latency spike followed by 504s to upstream auth service, timed around 10:05 UTC. That aligns with the cert rotation window.

maya (oncall): rolling back the cert rotation on the gateway nodes now (starting with 3/10).

ops-lead: If rollback reduces errors, customer-facing message should read: "Interruption caused by a recent configuration rollout; we have rolled back the change and traffic is being restored." Keep it short and non-technical. Do not assign blame.

support-sam: Draft DM for affected customers (short):

"Hi — we're investigating an interruption in Redwood hosted inference in US‑East. You may see errors or canceled streams. We're rolling back a recent configuration change and expect partial restoration in ~30 minutes. We'll follow up as service recovers. Sorry for the disruption. — Redwood Support"

lucy (comms): Enterprise email template (longer):
Subject: Service interruption affecting inference in us-east-1 — update
Body: Short summary, customer-visible impact, mitigation underway (rollback), ETA, any immediate suggested actions (none required; optional region routing), contact for escalation, link to status page and ticket reference.

ops-lead: Action items: maya continue mitigation; ashok validate rollback results; jordan publish status page draft and post initial update; lucy + support-sam prepare DM/email for top customers. Handoff planned in ~30m.

maya (oncall): rollback completed on 7/10 nodes — error rate down to ~6%. Pushing rollback to remaining nodes now.

incident-bot: Status update created on status.redwood.com/incident/2249991111

jordan: Posted initial status page update with neutral, concise wording. Will maintain 20m cadence for updates.

lucy (comms): Drafts uploaded to /comms/incidents/2249991111-drafts. Please review and comment quickly.

ops-lead: Handoff at 2249991411 — maya handing to ashok. ashok confirm you have runbook and log links.

ashok: Confirmed. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/2249991111. I have logs and traces; continuing validation. Next update planned at 2249991555.

maya (oncall): Handoff complete. Add me if you need anything.

support-sam: Sending initial DMs to top customers: acme-inc, beta-ml-app, partner-data.

lucy (comms): Final note for comms wording library: start with a clear impact statement, then customer-visible symptoms, then mitigation and ETA, then follow-up plan. Use placeholders: {{service}}, {{region}}, {{impact}}, {{eta}}, {{action}}. Keep tone accountable and empathetic; avoid blame and internal detail.

ops-lead: +1. We'll fold these templates into the comms snippets directory under "incident-snippets/simple-templates" and mark for review.

maya (oncall): Full rollback finished. 5xx back to baseline at 2249991555. Closing the loop — please add retro notes and finalize outbound comms.
